messages:
marta: Quick announce: preview of 'Evidence Export' for Private/VPC tenants launching canary next Tue. Purpose: let compliance teams pull a signed, redacted audit bundle from the local agent for legal requests. Opt-in, admin consent required.

marta: Key constraints: agent v3.2+, export bundles encrypted and HSM-signed, 30GB max per bundle (chunking available), 1 concurrent export per tenant, rate limit 3/hr. DPA addendum required for telemetry-including exports.

dom: Ops: adding export_queue metric and a per-tenant alert at backlog >5. Also adding a console toggle to pause exports for a tenant if needed.

liz: Security: will publish the public verification key for customers to validate signatures. Need to confirm key rotation cadence with infra.

ops-bot: deploy-schedule: canary enable 2026-04-21T09:00Z -> 2026-04-21T11:00Z. Auto-rollback if >1% failures.

marta: Customer API example (private console):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://private-console.redwood.example/api/v1/tenants/ORG/export" \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"since":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z","profile":"pii-redact","include_telemetry":false}'
```

sec-team: Legal needs draft addendum in /legal/drafts/evidence-export-addendum.md. CS needs consent checkbox in console flow and a record of approving admin identity.

marta: We'll publish runbook and SLAs: expected delivery <=24h for <5GB, <=72h for larger bundles. For emergency expedited requests there will be a separate workflow with approval. DM for demo tenant. :tada:
